cards.title: Continue up the beach line
mapFocus: (KTFP) Ingleside Regional Airport/East / South Arrivals/Port Royal
instructions: Continue up the beach line at 2,500' MSL · 240 KIAS
Once abeam Port Royal, proceed direct to Ingleside Regional (about 330°)
cards.source: Binder, pp. 55–58; Feb 2026 PPT, Part 2, slide 90.

cards.title: Descend into Ingleside
instructions: Maintain 2,500' MSL · 200 KIAS direct to Ingleside Regional
Once feet dry over Ingleside, begin your descent
cards.detail: Transitions to and from Ingleside conflict with multiple VFR routes and IFR approaches. Be alert for IFR traffic at 1,600' MSL and stay below 3,000' MSL unless in contact with Corpus Approach.
cards.source: Binder, pp. 55–58; Feb 2026 PPT, Part 2, slide 91.
